The scatter plot above shows the relationship between the number of absences in a month and the size of a class. How many absences were there in a class whose size is $20$ students?
worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13934290/assets/8088e41a66b4aba259d95f3099f71d5777caf876e9278e6b7f11c865ab12f7e0.png)

To determine the number of absences there were in a class whose size is $20$ students, we locate $20$ on the horizontal axis and move in the vertical direction until we find some points, as shown above.

The highlighted point has coordinates $(20,6).$ Therefore, there was a total of $6$ absences in the month for the class with $20$ students.
